name: minimax-m3.1-flash-free
_comment: OpenCode Go model (https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/go): free for a limited time. Specs from official MiniMax docs (platform.minimaxi.com/docs/guides/text-generation, /docs/api-reference/text-chat-openai): natively multimodal (text/image/video input), 1M context, max_tokens recommended 131072 (cap 524288), effort low..max (default max when omitted), adaptive thinking always on, and tool-call rounds must replay reasoning_content (interleaved thinking).
